annotations.title: List FRC Event Keys by Year

description: List every FRC event key for a season year (strings like '2024casj', '2024nyro', '2024micmp4'). Lightest events enumeration; useful for driving subsequent per-event queries with minimal bandwidth.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_events_keys
